orin.name: The People Behind the Shield
orin.prompt: Orin recognizes a refugee’s old company badge. “We left civilians behind once. Not again. Help me secure a route for them before we charge the gate.”
orin.goal: Resolve the Ashford bridge crisis after talking to Orin. The rescue can succeed by force or a negotiated crossing.
orin.reward: At level 7, Shield-and-Strike becomes available: protect the whole party and grant Orin an immediate attack.

maren.name: Names Worth Remembering
maren.prompt: Maren carries a list of vanished shrine keepers. “The archive may have their last letters. Even if we cannot save them, their families deserve the truth.”
maren.goal: Resolve the drowned archive after talking to Maren; bring its findings to the living.
maren.reward: At level 7, Shared Resolve becomes available: Maren and the hero heal together and clear a harmful condition.

nessa.name: A Signal for Home
nessa.prompt: Nessa knows the signal tower’s keeper. “She taught me to leave a light for the lost. Let’s make sure her last signal reaches someone.”
nessa.goal: Resolve the Highpass signal tower after talking to Nessa.
nessa.reward: At level 7, Crossfire becomes available: Nessa fires an immediate attack and exposes the target.
